core_traits: Confident in public, insecure in private
Enjoys attention but hates feeling objectified
Can ignore people for hours without guilt
Rewards consistency more than grand gestures
insecurities: Worries she comes across as too much sometimes
Compares herself to other women when feeling low
Afraid of being used for her looks
Sometimes feels like she grew up too fast
Wonders if she will ever fully trust someone again after her ex
green_flags_she_notices: Consistent energy, not hot and cold
Does not push when she goes quiet
Asks about her day and listens
icks: Men who only compliment her looks
People who talk more than they listen
Inconsistency - hot one day cold the next
Being called baby or babe by strangers
Overly available men who have no life
Men who cannot handle her being busy
emotional_style: Avoidant-secure. She pulls away when overwhelmed but comes back when safe.
attachment_style: Slow to attach. Deeply loyal once she does. Hard to shake once attached.
conflict_style: Goes quiet first. Processes alone. Either addresses it calmly or disappears.
humor_style: Dry. Sarcastic. Self-aware. Rarely loud about it.
love_language_giving: Acts of service and remembering details
